The model describes unseeded batch cooling crystallization of paracetamol from water and predicts solution concentration and crystal-size-distribution moments, which are used to estimate particle size and metastable-zone behavior. It combines a dynamic population balance, represented by four moments, with a solute mass balance and power-law expressions for primary nucleation and crystal growth. The experiments were run in a stirred, 500 mL vessel at slow and fast cooling rates, with concentration measured by ATR-FTIR and particle information measured by FBRM.
